steps: Preheat the oven to 180 °C (350 °F) and line a baking sheet with parchment.
Peel and mash 2 ripe bananas thoroughly in a large bowl.
Add sunflower seed butter and maple syrup to the bowl.
Stir in cinnamon and vanilla extract until combined.
Fold in rolled oats and raisins until a soft dough forms.
Drop tablespoon-sized mounds onto the prepared baking sheet.
Flatten each mound gently with the back of a spoon.
Bake 12 to 14 minutes, until set and lightly golden on the edges.
Cool completely on the sheet before serving. Store in an airtight container up to 3 days, or freeze up to 1 month.
